entries.title: Philippians 2:9
segments: The name which is above every name. Christ made the supreme sacrifice. Salvation had to come from above and none other was equal to the task.  It was accomplished once for all. entries.title: Philippians 2:20
segments: No man likeminded. Timothy had a peculiar and whole-souled interest in the church at Philippi, which would lead him to bring to Paul a more exhaustive report than he would get from any one else.

entries.title: Philippians 2:21
segments: for they all seek their own. Paul's workers were too closely interested each in his own particular field to give intimate attention to the spiritual condition of the Philippians.

entries.title: Philippians 2:23
segments: How it will go with me. The reference here is to the outcome of Paul's long imprisonment, and the expected trial in the near future.

entries.title: Philippians 2:25
segments: Epaphroditus. he had been the bearer of gifts to Paul from the brethren at Philippi, and upon his return, Paul sends by him this epistle to the Philippians.
